card.name: Spots before a V-name or spelling
card.fires_on: Punctuation, joining words or digits right before a foreign or variant word that starts with V, Va or Ve, such as etymology lines and alternate spellings. It also fires inside digit strings in names and dates.

modes.label: Etymology and variant spellings
modes.description: A linking word or symbol just before a cited related word or alternate spelling.

modes.label: Digits inside dates or numbers
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a date or number, often near a V-initial name.

modes.label: Inside a brand name
modes.description: A letter partway through a drug brand name that continues into VA or VE.
modes.example: Interactions with FL<<A>>VALTA Risk of Severe

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuations that begin with V, such as Ve, Va, VE or VA.
card.plain: It fires at the spot just before a word starting with V is expected, often in word-origin notes or alternate spellings.
